source_snapshot.procedure: Verify recipe, clear logs, collect full IB/OOB SDR lists, collect IB/OOB Sensor Lists filtered by TEMP_PDB, inspect BMC Web Sensor List, save results/photos and inspect new logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: SDR and Sensor List names, descriptions and readings, plus BMC Web information, match the SPEC.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek fabricates `Sensor Check - PDB` as a sensor identifier, collects only OOB data, truncates SDR, omits both IB paths and BMC Web, exposes the password in an argument and reduces a multi-sensor SPEC comparison to one value.

original_test_intent.purpose: Verify every platform-defined PDB temperature sensor against the approved specification across complete in-band and out-of-band SDR and Sensor List evidence plus the BMC Web Sensor List.
original_test_intent.target: The exact `TEMP_PDB` sensor population mapped by the product specification for one verified SUT/BMC/firmware pair; the testcase title is not itself a sensor identifier.
original_test_intent.scope: Complete IB and OOB `sdr elist`, the complete PDB subset from IB and OOB `sensor list`, and corresponding BMC Web entries, with pre/post log evidence. It is not a single OOB `sensor get` or truncated SDR sample.
original_test_intent.operation: Preserve a baseline, collect untruncated read-only evidence from both IPMI paths and Web, derive the exact PDB set using the owner map, compare each sensor's identity/description/reading and applicable representation to SPEC, reconcile every interface and inspect post-collection log deltas.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One collection from each required view. The source records 3 attended and 0 machine minutes; zero machine time does not authorize omission of any command or Web evidence.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Every required PDB sensor is present and uniquely mapped in all applicable views, and each source-required name, description and reading plus the BMC Web information matches the exact platform SPEC under only owner-approved sampling/rounding rules; no unexplained new log event occurs.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: SUT/BMC/firmware and PDB sensor-spec revision; PDB inventory and alias mapping; complete raw IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List outputs; exact derived TEMP_PDB rows; BMC Web captures/export; timestamps; raw and normalized per-sensor comparison; missing/duplicate/disagreement and log-delta results; secret-safe audit.
ambiguities: The authoritative PDB sensor inventory, exact names/descriptions/readings and accepted aliases are absent.
Permitted time skew, UI rounding, unit/status/threshold representation and equivalence across IB, OOB and Web are absent.
The source requests log clearing without an export/authorization rule.
The zero machine-time value conflicts with the nonzero evidence-collection work only as an estimate ambiguity, not as permission to skip the work.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly rejects the title-as-sensor substitution and requires alias resolution, protected read-only access and SPEC comparison. It incorrectly makes the source-required BMC Web view optional/supplemental and calls the complete activity FULLY AUTOMATABLE even though the product sensor map/SPEC and Web evidence path must be supplied or confirmed.

applicable_history.decision: Multiple rows share code Wistron-HW-00483-V002 but represent different test variants; only Functionality row 2274 governs this PDB case. V2's row-specific scope is authoritative over unrelated PWR/telemetry variants but its Web and classification conclusions remain reviewable.

The structurally equivalent motherboard-sensor case correctly uses REQUIRES because complete command Actual Values are automatable while Web evidence and final SPEC correctness require a supplied product map/evidence path. This is a consistency precedent, not copied case reasoning.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Reclassify from FULLY to REQUIRES. Command-side collection is read-only and automatable, but the complete requested test also mandates BMC Web evidence and authoritative PDB SPEC/mapping. Those are provider-closable dependencies, not a semantic BLOCKED condition.

available_now: The exact five evidence views are explicit: IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web Sensor List.
All command Actual Values can be collected read-only before the expected matrix is provided, and visible Web values can also be captured if authorized access exists; neither alone supports PASS.
missing_inputs: The BMC/platform owner must supply the exact PDB sensor inventory, aliases, expected name/description/reading and any unit/status/threshold or sampling/rounding equivalence rules.
The lab/automation owner must supply an approved ipmitool, protected IB/OOB access, BMC Web credentials/evidence path and a safe log-baseline policy.
If source-requested log clearing is required, the system owner must authorize it only after baseline export; otherwise the owner must approve timestamp-delta handling.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The BMC/platform owner supplies the PDB SPEC and mapping; the lab/automation owner supplies protected command/Web access; the system owner controls log-clear authorization.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Collect and hash complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List outputs and current BMC Web Sensor List without clearing logs, retaining all stdout/stderr/status and timestamps.

Derive a candidate TEMP_PDB set and report every unmatched, duplicate or cross-path discrepancy as unresolved, without assigning PASS. If target identity, credential safety and platform health remain sound, complete the other bounded read-only views before stopping verdict interpretation.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not query the testcase title as a sensor, truncate SDR, collect only OOB, omit Web, expose passwords in arguments/logs, silently choose one duplicate/alias, normalize without an approved rule, clear unexported logs, write thresholds/reset sensors or declare PASS without the product SPEC.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Match the PDB SPEC revision to the exact firmware, reconcile every required PDB sensor across all five views, retain raw and normalized values, account for logs and apply only approved equivalence rules before owner disposition.

revision_candidate.test_name: PDB Temperature Sensor Consistency Across IB, OOB and BMC Web
revision_candidate.purpose: Verify the complete platform-defined PDB temperature-sensor set and its SPEC-defined information across both IPMI paths and BMC Web.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact server PDB, BMC firmware and sensor schema with authorized host IPMI, protected RMCP+ and BMC Web access and the matching product PDB sensor specification.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every required TEMP_PDB/PDB sensor in complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List evidence plus corresponding BMC Web entries, once per interface; no sensor stimulus, threshold write or reset.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Verified SUT/BMC/PDB/firmware identity; PDB sensor SPEC and inventory/alias map; expected fields and interface-equivalence rules; approved ipmitool/cipher/endpoints; secret-safe credentials; Web evidence path; synchronized timestamps; log-baseline policy; evidence storage.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Export and hash existing logs before an authorized clear, or use an approved timestamp marker. Collect complete IB and protected OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` outputs with raw status/errors, derive the TEMP_PDB subset without discarding full evidence, capture every corresponding BMC Web Sensor List entry and compare each mapped sensor with SPEC while retaining raw values and discrepancies.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct SUT/BMC/PDB/firmware verified; product SPEC available for verdict; ipmitool and authorized secret-safe IB/OOB access ready; BMC Web evidence path authorized; clocks/sample window recorded; logs preserved; no concurrent firmware or sensor-policy change.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Identity/version/spec/timestamps and log baseline; complete raw IB/OOB SDR and Sensor Lists; exact derived TEMP_PDB rows; BMC Web captures/export; expected-versus-observed matrix for every PDB sensor; raw and approved-normalized fields; command/UI errors; missing/duplicate/stale/disagreeing rows; no-write audit and post-collection log delta.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The owner-approved PDB sensor specification for the exact hardware and BMC firmware, plus source requirements that SDR and Sensor List names, descriptions and readings and BMC Web information match that SPEC.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Read-only sensor collection. Do not expose secrets, truncate raw evidence, omit an interface, clear unexported logs, write thresholds or sensor state, reset BMC/sensors, fabricate a sensor from the title, hide disagreement or infer equivalence without an approved map.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: No interactive approval is required for already-authorized read-only collection. Owner input is required for the product SPEC/mapping, Web evidence path and final discrepancy judgment; explicit approval is required before any log clear.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Automation can collect and compare all command views. An operator or approved browser harness must supply the required BMC Web evidence unless an authenticated export exists; the BMC engineer resolves aliases, sampling/rounding and expected readings.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: No functional recovery is expected for read-only collection. Immediately stop on wrong target, credential exposure, platform-health fault or any proposed mutation and preserve evidence. For incomplete, missing, duplicate, stale, ambiguous or disagreeing data, withhold PASS but finish the remaining authorized bounded read-only views when target/security/health remain sound; correct the access/map before at most one approved recollection.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Immediately stop collection for wrong SUT/BMC/PDB/firmware, credential exposure, unapproved log clear, BMC/thermal fault, transport behavior that threatens availability or any proposed write/reset. For incomplete/truncated output, absent Web evidence, unavailable SPEC, missing/duplicate/ambiguous/stale/invalid sensors, cross-path disagreement or unapproved normalization, stop PASS interpretation and preserve the discrepancy; complete remaining safe bounded read-only views only if target identity, credential safety and platform health are still confirmed.

identified_defects: DeepSeek replaces the PDB sensor family with a fabricated title string, omits three source-required views and truncates evidence.
DeepSeek places the password on the command line and asks a user to judge one value instead of reconciling the full sensor set.
V2 demotes the explicitly required BMC Web Sensor List to optional supplemental evidence.
V2's FULLY AUTOMATABLE class ignores the required product SPEC/mapping and Web evidence handoff.
V2 does not preserve the 3/0 timing facts or provide a controlled interpretation of source-requested log clearing.
reason_for_change: Restore the source-required BMC Web evidence and full PDB sensor population, make the SPEC/evidence handoff explicit and prevent a command-only partial workflow from being mislabeled as complete automation.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-HW-00483-V002, PDB variant
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Only Functionality row 2274; the code has two other workbook variants
new_technical_evidence.supports: The source explicitly mandates full IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB TEMP_PDB Sensor List and BMC Web Sensor List, all compared with SPEC, with 3 attended and 0 machine minutes.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The PDB sensor map, expected values, cross-interface equivalence and Web automation path are not supplied.

removed_ambiguities: Defines five mandatory evidence views instead of making Web optional.
Treats TEMP_PDB as a specification-defined sensor set and the title as a label, not a sensor ID.
Separates immediately collectable Actual Values from SPEC-dependent correctness and final PASS.
Explains that zero machine time is an estimate rather than permission to omit machine-collected evidence.
resolved_blockers: Missing expected values do not prevent complete read-only Actual Value collection.
The Web and SPEC dependencies support REQUIRES rather than permanent BLOCKED.
remaining_blockers: Final completion and PASS await the PDB sensor SPEC/map, all required Web evidence, approved equivalence rules and disposition of any cross-path/log discrepancy.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 restores a mandatory source interface that V2 dropped, applies the formal complete-activity classification boundary and prevents one invented OOB sensor query from masquerading as the full PDB consistency test.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The first validator pass found a TEST_CASE_DOCUMENT_DEFECT: a generic cross-path-disagreement stop could suppress remaining safe read-only evidence. V3 was corrected to separate immediate target/security/health/mutation stops from discrepancies that stop PASS interpretation but allow the other bounded views when safe. Revalidation recovered all five views, every mapped PDB sensor, one collection per interface, raw-evidence retention, SPEC-dependent acceptance and no-write boundaries; no material document defect remains.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Functionality row 2274 requires complete IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB TEMP_PDB Sensor List and BMC Web Sensor List evidence against SPEC, with 3 attended and 0 machine minutes.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 resolves the sensor-name problem but incorrectly makes the mandatory Web view supplemental and therefore overstates complete automation readiness.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow all authorized read-only Actual Value collection before SPEC arrival; prohibit secret exposure, truncation, log clearing, sensor writes/resets and PASS without all five views plus the owner map.
